'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Artisan found with [[Dingan]] in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Yanguang:''' These Kernel Puppets are all fixed. You can take them.
:'''Dingan:''' Finished in one day? I thought it would take longer than that.

==Dialogue==
:'''Yanguang:''' These Kernel Puppets are all fixed. You can take them.

:'''Dingan:''' Finished in one day? I thought it would take longer than that.

:'''Yanguang:''' None of them had any major problems. Just dust and grime stuck in the joints from all that patrolling. A good oiling did the trick.

:'''Yanguang:''' Remember to bring them in for regular upkeep. Even Autopuppets need "rest."

:'''Yanguang:''' Oh, right. Those other ones weren't an easy fix. Problems with their kernels. We'll need to find replacement parts before we can fix them.
{{Dialogue End}}
